name: Knott's Charleston Circle Coffee / Marketplace StarbucksSous-Vide Egg Bites, Rolled Oatmeal & Banana
brandOrRestaurant: Charleston Circle Coffee & California Marketplace Starbucks (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Available inside Knott's (Charleston Circle / Marketplace), Disneyland (Market House), and DCA (Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe): Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites, plain Classic Rolled Oatmeal, and a ripe banana are a universal 9.0/10 theme-park safety net.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Classic Oatmeal (no nut packet), Bacon & Gruyère Sous-Vide Egg Bites (Gruyère is aged and naturally lactose-safe), or a Turkey Bacon Egg-White Sandwich on an English muffin.
watchOuts: Discard the mixed-nut packet that comes with the oatmeal; avoid citrus refreshers/lemonades
